reading: The sketch lays out a cloud-drive file manager: a left sidebar with Drive navigation links and a storage usage indicator, a breadcrumb trail, a toolbar with New folder/Sort/Upload buttons, a grid of 8 file/folder tiles with one selected, and a right-hand details panel for the selected file, all per the typed notes.
